# T-3: Bind report freshness

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Persist and validate the exact Git and source-artifact authority for a generated report.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R5 report binding records target Git values and every consumed source artifact hash.
- R6 malformed and stale bindings return the specified failure codes.
- R7 retains named report text sections and existing data keys while successful delivery gains only additive fields.

## Implementation Notes
Use SHA-256 over consumed bytes and project-relative paths. Reuse existing Git/tree and artifact validation patterns; make the freshness checker compare all recorded binding elements.

## Test Strategy
Add spec-local tests for unchanged binding, changed issue-log/artifact, changed tree/HEAD, missing binding, malformed binding, optional-absent artifact omission, and existing report text/data parity.
